annotations.title: Score an architecture or interior design studio website

description: Scores an architecture or interior design studio website out of 100 from 14 yes / partly / no checks (project pages, plans and drawings, photography, the studio and services pages, ways to start a project, phone layout, share previews), and returns the fixes ordered by how much each one matters, plus a written website brief. Use when someone wants their studio or portfolio website reviewed. Send the answers that are known; the checks still unanswered come back with their wording, and the score appears once all 14 are answered.

answers.description: One answer per check: yes, partly or no. Leave out a check that is not known yet.

c1.description: A way to start a project is on every page

c2.description: The contact form asks what a first call needs. Project type, location and timing, not only name and email.

c3.description: Your email, phone and city are easy to find

p1.description: The site works on a phone. Open it on your phone: readable text, a menu that works, nothing scrolls sideways.

p2.description: Each page has its own title, description and share image. Paste a project link into a chat with yourself. If the preview shows that project's name and photo, answer Yes.

s1.description: A studio page names the people who lead the work, with a photo

s2.description: Services say what you do and how a project runs, step by step

s3.description: Clients' own words are on the site, with their names. Quotes from named clients, or press that wrote about your work.

w1.description: Every project has its own page. Not only a photo in a grid: a page you can send to a client.

w2.description: Each project page lists the facts: place, year, size and scope

w3.description: Projects show a plan or a drawing, not only photographs

w4.description: Photographs are large and look like one set. The same light and colour across projects, shown big.

w5.description: Your latest finished project is on the site

journal.description: Whether the studio will write about its work a few times a year. Default false.

project_count.description: How many projects the studio wants to show on the site. Default 6.

studio_type.description: What the studio designs: buildings (architecture), interiors, or both. Default both.
